currentDevelopment.runtimeState: owner-installed; Ocean contrast and full workspace render are improved, but zoom adaptation and Layers collapsed/footer UX still need correction

release.notes: Zoom now adapts to Inspector state: horizontal beside expanded Inspector, separate same-width vertical pill below compact collapsed Inspector. Collapsed Layers hides actual layer/file content. Expanded Layers footer is wide real local project folder + small add button; disconnected folder action invokes the existing owner directory picker and connected action opens the existing local project explorer. Ocean top control groups use one consistent translucent substrate without per-button outlines.
